label: early-middle original steps (t=3-6) on first-occurrence o/3/r/z/p, or <DEL>
explanation: Fires only at steps t=3..7 (peak t=4), in the late original phase (67% of mass) or on the <DEL> step when L is 3-6 (33%). It never fires in the copy phase or at t<3. In the original phase it is token-selective: o, 3 and r give about 4x lift, z and p about 2x. It fires almost only on the first occurrence of the input token (97% of mass). The predicate covers 87% of activation mass and 82% of active steps, but precision is only about 11%: most steps matching the context stay below threshold. History helps somewhat (a preceding w/k/u/e, or a first token of 0, raises the rate and the top examples often have w just before), but no simple history condition fixes precision. Top activations are o/3/r right after w at t=4.
